links.outcome: Guideline-concordant accuracy of LLM answers to otolaryngology questions, graded by blinded otolaryngologists
links.effect: o1: 73% correct, 26% partially correct, 1% incorrect (mean 0.86); GPT-4o: 64% correct, 36% partially correct, 0% incorrect (mean 0.82); difference not significant (paired t test P=0.165).
links.quote: Both models thus supplied predominantly guideline-concordant information, and specialty tuning conferred only a modest, nonsignificant benefit in this data set.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o and o1 model performance and guideline adherence on 100 otolaryngology questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
